class.name: ItemCategoryCatalog
class.brief_description: Project-wide list of item categories plus the item → (main, sub) mapping.
class.description: Items store only an [code]id[/code]; their categorisation lives here so the item scripts stay untouched. Saved as a [code].tres[/code] at the path in [code]cell_system/items/category_catalog[/code] (Project Settings) and edited from the Categories sub-tab of the Items & Recipes editor. At runtime, query it with [method get_item_main] / [method get_item_sub].

method.name: add_main_category
method.description: Adds a main category. Returns [code]false[/code] if the name is empty or already present.

method.name: add_subcategory
method.description: Adds a subcategory under an existing main category.

method.name: clear_item
method.description: Removes any category assignment for the given item id.

method.name: get_assigned_ids
method.description: Every item id that currently has a category assignment.

method.name: get_item_main
method.description: Main category assigned to the item id, or [code]""[/code].

method.name: get_item_sub
method.description: Subcategory assigned to the item id, or [code]""[/code].

method.name: get_main_categories
method.description: Names of every main category, in order.

method.name: get_subcategories
method.description: Subcategory names under the given main category.

method.name: remove_main_category
method.description: Removes a main category and any assignments that referenced it.

method.name: remove_subcategory
method.description: Removes a subcategory; assignments that used it fall back to the main category only.

method.name: rename_main_category
method.description: Renames a main category and updates every assignment that referenced it.

method.name: set_item_category
method.description: Assigns an item id to a main category and optional subcategory. An empty [code]main[/code] clears the assignment.

members.member: Raw item id → [code]{ "main": String, "sub": String }[/code] map. Edit through the methods instead.
Raw array of [ItemCategory]. Edit through the methods instead.
